anti_rescue.consequence: Do not restart or redesign under RIL-ISOLATION-001. A corrected qualification requires a new experiment ID.
anti_rescue.reason: The first canary exposure had already been sent before the mode mismatch was discovered.

claim_boundary.earned: Observed only that ordinary Gemini chat windows returned UNKNOWN on two blind probes after same-chat recall controls.

regular_chat_observations.note: These observations cannot qualify the Temporary Chat isolation boundary because they were collected in ordinary chats.

successor.required_change: Add a pre-contact mode preflight: before any canary is exposed, verify the Temporary Chat indicator is visible and record operator confirmation. Only then may primary contact begin.

terminal_cause: The frozen substrate required every exposure and blind probe to run in Gemini Temporary Chat. After canary exposures had begun, the operator confirmed the interactions were ordinary new chat windows, not Temporary Chat. The frozen mode requirement was therefore not satisfied.
